title: Excellence Awards 2025 Announced: Celebrating Outstanding Entrepreneurs Who Drive Innovation
text:
Excellence Awards 2025 Announced: Celebrating Outstanding Entrepreneurs Who Drive Innovation By: AB Newswire March 12, 2025 at 18:08 PM EDT The Excellence Awards are proud to announce the winners of the Entrepreneur of the Year Awards 2025 ! This year’s winners represent an extraordinary caliber of visionaries, innovators, and leaders who are shaping the future of business through their ingenuity, resilience, and groundbreaking contributions.
Honoring Excellence
The Excellence Awards , hosted as part of Dr Yasemin Yazan LLC , were established to recognize and celebrate individuals who drive progress and inspire others through their outstanding contributions. The Entrepreneur of the Year Awards spotlight those who transform industries, redefine business models, and create impactful solutions that contribute to economic growth and societal advancement.
“Entrepreneurship is about vision, determination, and the courage to innovate. This year’s awardees exemplify what it means to lead with purpose and make a lasting impact.” – Dr Yasemin Yazan, Founder and Editor-in-Chief of the Excellence Awards.
Entrepreneur of the Year Awards 2025
Celebrating the Winners:
Dr Bijna Kotak Dasani – Finance & Venture Capital
Gabriela Kouahla – Localization for Mediterranean Researchers
Michelle Harris – Wellness & Wellbeing
Misha Agrawal – Sustainability & Eco-Friendly Products
Naomi Lucas – Education & EdTech
Reham Amin – Language Services & Technology
Suhaib Siddiqi – Innovation in Antiviral Therapeutics
Yash Rathore – Retail Innovation
From finance and technology to sustainability and education, this year’s winners have demonstrated exceptional leadership in their fields. Their work is shaping industries, advancing innovation, and setting new benchmarks for entrepreneurial excellence.
Looking Ahead
This year’s winners will be prominently featured in the A-Z Listing of Winners on the Excellence Awards website and honored in the upcoming edition of the Excellence Awards Magazine. Their achievements serve as an inspiration for future generations of entrepreneurs, showcasing what is possible through innovation, resilience, and leadership.
“Great entrepreneurs don’t just create businesses — they create opportunities, solve problems, and leave a lasting legacy.” – Mona Tenjo, Co-Editor-in-Chief.
Discover more about this year’s inspiring winners and the Excellence Awards at www.excellenceawards.global .
About the Excellence Awards
The Excellence Awards, hosted as part of Dr Yasemin Yazan LLC, are dedicated to recognizing outstanding individuals and organizations that drive progress and innovation across industries. By celebrating excellence in entrepreneurship, the awards aim to inspire and empower business leaders and changemakers worldwide.
The Excellence Awards are proudly presented by Dr Yasemin Yazan, Mona Tenjo, and Almaz Andezion.
For inquiries, please contact: info@excellenceawards.global.
